content:
Apple TV has had a stellar year, with its newest show Small Prophets being hailed as the best premiere of 2026 for the streaming platform. Below are summaries of reviews from various media outlets.

《Small Prophets》獲評論盛讚為 Apple TV「傑作」

Apple TV has a strong comedy lineup this year, including new seasons of 《Shrinking》、《Ted Lasso》and 《Trying》, as well as the hit original series 《Widow's Bay》—the latter of which shone brightly at the Emmy Awards.

Now, its latest comedy 《Small Prophets》looks set to continue this strong momentum.

《Small Prophets》will premiere tonight at 9 PM Eastern Time / 6 PM Pacific Time, with critical acclaim pouring in.

We already knew 《Small Prophets》was beloved, given that it is one of the rare Apple TV shows to be licensed out. The series previously aired in the UK, and now Apple is bringing it to a global audience.

A fresh wave of reviews further confirms that 《Small Prophets》is something special. The series holds a 100% fresh rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Below is the review from The Hollywood Reporter:

The Verge's review also offered high praise:

Reviews from other outlets have also called it 「a gentle, exquisitely crafted, unhurried masterpiece」, with one critic exclaiming: 「The interweaving of storylines is the work of a genius.」

In short, if you finish the Season 4 finale of 《Ted Lasso》tonight and still want more, Apple TV definitely has you covered with another brilliant comedy.

Are you planning to watch 《Small Prophets》? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, or you can subscribe at a discount through the Apple One bundle.
